description: 28 developer questions mapped to source files in the moss repository at commit 731ab74 (2026-11-01). Expected paths were checked against that source tree. This evaluates retrieval against one current corpus; it is not representative of other repositories.

queries.query: How does Moss decide which provider to dispatch a task to and what the fallback order is?
Where is the fixed provider lane order defined as the single source of truth?
What happens when no provider is available to run a task? Which error is raised?
How does Moss talk to a local Ollama model to generate text?
How does Moss detect whether the codex or copilot CLI binary is installed on PATH?
Where are outbound HTTP network calls restricted to localhost endpoints?
Which subprocess commands is Moss allowed to run, and where is the allowlist?
How does Moss run an external command safely and capture stdout and stderr?
How are capabilities gated by milestone so features cannot be used before they ship?
What error is thrown when a capability is used before its scheduled milestone?
How does Moss load a skill by id from the skills directory on disk?
How is a skill's YAML frontmatter split, parsed and validated?
How does Moss execute a skill against a room and route the generation?
How does Moss persist a new memory entry to disk?
How do I search or recall saved memory entries by query or tag?
How are memory entries compacted into a single summary file?
How does Moss verify an MCP tool is allowlisted before calling it?
How does Moss connect to a locally-run MCP server over HTTP JSON-RPC?
How is the LiteLLM endpoint config loaded and validated as localhost-only?
How does Moss produce a git diff of a target repo for review?
How does Moss detect that the target git repository was mutated during a run?
Where are all the moss CLI subcommands registered with commander?
What environment and tooling does the doctor command check?
How does the run command execute a skill against a repo and write a report?
How does Moss pick the best model for a task kind such as code-review?
How does Moss make sure resolved file paths stay inside the project root?
How does Moss classify a document by extension and decide if it is convertible?
How are eval responses scored deterministically across dimensions?
